column1: # The component a radical form is searched under in the descriptions, where it is not the unified
# ideograph Unicode's EquivalentUnifiedIdeograph.txt pairs it with. `scripts/build_open_strokes.mjs`
# reads a wanted form inside the characters written with the component named here.
# Every form of the CJK Radicals Supplement left without a stroke order was drawn beside its Unicode
# pair and beside each component BabelStone IDS names three times or more, in Noto Sans CJK JP 2.004
# (2026-11-15). The font draws all but the forms below with their pair's outline or nearest to it.

column3: Unicode pairs ⺫ (U+2EAB, CJK RADICAL EYE) with 目, but it is drawn lying on its side with the outline of 罒 (U+7F52); the descriptions write that shape 罒
